name: vex-helper
description: Generate VEX from intent, lint it without Houdini, and compile-check it for real by cooking an Attribute Wrangle.

sources.used_for: naming parity with its create_wrangle/validate_vex tools; independent implementation
NOTHING - not merged, cited only as evidence the category is in demand

wrangle_kind.description: Wrangle binding class. The values below are what this repo's resolver accepts; the real menu differs per build, so an unavailable choice raises parm_choice_unavailable listing the actual items (22.0.368: detail, primitive, point, vertex, number).

Wrangle binding class. The values below are what this repo's resolver accepts; the real menu differs per build, so an unavailable choice raises parm_choice_unavailable listing the actual items (22.0.368: detail, primitive, point, vertex, number). Ignored for volumewrangle templates: that node has no class menu (verified on 22.0.368).

node_type.description: Which node the code is cooked in. Both verified on 22.0.368: volumewrangle has snippet/autobind/bindeach/bindings/exportlist/group and NO class parm; a template's own node_type is used when this is omitted. Same VEX in the wrong node compiles with 0 errors and does nothing, so this is not a cosmetic choice.
